description_en: Copies the current mitigation template and generates a new mitigation template
description_zh: 复制当前防护模板，并生成一个新的防护模板
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi copy-defense-template --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-lbj0000x10g --template-id 12345 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyDefenseTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the mitigation template to copy
parameters.help_zh: 要复制的防护规则模板ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run mode. If you do not specify this parameter, a normal request is sent. Valid values:
true: A dry run request is sent. The system checks whether the request meets the execution conditions without performing the specified operation. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the dry run succeeds, the error code Defense.Control.DryRunOperation is returned.
false: A normal request is sent. The specified operation is performed after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启 DryRun 预检模式。如果不输入该参数，表示发起正常请求。取值：
true：表示发起预检请求，仅检查请求是否满足执行条件，不执行请求指定的操作。预检不通过时返回相应错误码；预检通过时返回错误码Defense.Control.DryRunOperation。
false：表示发起正常请求；检查通过后执行请求指定的操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the mitigation template generated by the copy operation
